name: First run, restart, and progress stay reliable
description: Checks the portal-to-puzzle onboarding flow and confirms a restart returns to a playable board.
steps: Open Jam Shift on a fresh save
Tap Play level 01
Read the quick guide and choose Got it — let's play!
Make an invalid swap, choose Restart level, and confirm the restart
Tap two adjacent candies
expected: First-time players receive a dismissible guide; level 1 starts with a fair board, restart confirms before resetting, and controls respond again.

name: Tap, swipe, and keyboard controls resolve adjacent moves
description: Verifies touch and keyboard interactions, plus the two-cell goal-focused hint.
steps: Start a level and dismiss the guide if shown
Choose Show me a move and observe the two highlighted candies
Swap the hinted pair using taps
Restart and confirm, then swipe a candy toward an adjacent cell
Use Tab and arrow keys to navigate the candy board
expected: The hint highlights both adjacent candies for a legal move; tap, swipe, and keyboard input resolve valid swaps, while invalid swaps return cleanly.

name: Matches, cascades, and objectives settle cleanly
description: Checks that a normal turn resolves, feedback settles, and the next legal move remains available.
steps: Start a level
Make a valid match
Wait for falls and cascades to settle
Check score, moves, and objective progress
Continue until the board reshuffles if no legal moves remain
expected: Successful moves consume one move, cascades update score and objectives, and deadlock recovery leaves a full, match-free board with at least one legal move.

name: Special candy effects and combinations
covers: parallel and perpendicular striped pairs clear the same centered cross
description: Exercises special creation and combo effects through the visible gameplay flow.
steps: Play until a four-match creates a striped candy
Create a five-match color candy and an L/T wrapped candy
Activate specials and swap special pairs
Wait for chained clears to settle
expected: Match shapes create specials; every striped-plus-striped swap clears one full row and one full column regardless of stripe orientation, and special swaps consume both candies without leaving the board locked.

name: Special-candy activation milestones
covers: secondary activation targets on levels 15, 35, 55, 75, and 95
special creation does not count as activation
activation counter persists across moves and cascades
both objectives are required to win
objective progress and accessibility text update
description: Confirms that the five authored campaign milestones require actually firing specials and preserve that progress through normal gameplay.
steps: Using a QA save with milestone levels unlocked, open levels 15, 35, 55, 75, and 95 and verify activation targets of 1, 2, 2, 3, and 3 alongside the original goal
On a milestone, make a four-match and confirm the new special is created without advancing the activation counter
Activate the special in a later clear and verify the counter and combined progress bar update
Leave the original goal incomplete and confirm the level does not win; finish both goals to confirm the normal win flow
expected: Only specials actually included in a clear count; the activation total persists between moves, updates in the HUD, and cannot substitute for the level’s original objective.

name: Sugar rush cascade-chain milestones
covers: both objectives are required to win
description: Checks that cascade challenges reward a genuine chain from one move and preserve the best chain achieved during the level.
steps: Using a QA save, open levels 12, 32, 52, 72, and 92 and verify chain targets of 2, 2, 3, 3, and 3 alongside their color-collect goals
On a milestone, make a match with no follow-up and confirm the best-chain counter records one wave without completing a 2-wave target
Plan a move that creates an automatic refill cascade; confirm the chain counter advances and remains after later turns
Complete the color objective while the chain target is incomplete and confirm the level does not win
Reach the required chain depth and finish the color objective to verify the normal win and score-bonus flow
expected: Only a single move's actual cascade waves count toward the best-chain record. The record persists for the level, and both the chain and color-collect goals are required to win.

name: Jam jar ingredient-drop milestones
covers: jam jars are visible non-matchable board pieces
jars cannot be swapped or cleared directly
column gravity drops jars through cleared spaces
delivery progress and mixed-goal win checks
booster and special effects preserve ingredients
hint moves favor clears beneath a jar
description: Checks the new gravity-driven ingredient objective and its interaction with normal clears, specials, boosters, and mixed goals.
steps: Using a QA save, open levels 25, 45, 64, and 85 and verify ingredient targets of 1, 1, 2, and 2 alongside each original goal
On level 25, try selecting, swapping, and targeting the jam jar with a booster; confirm it stays in place and no move or booster charge is spent
Clear candies below the jar in its column, first with a normal match and then with a line or color effect; watch it fall with gravity and deliver at the bottom
Verify the delivered counter updates and the jar is removed only on delivery
Complete the original objective while leaving a jar undelivered and confirm the level does not win; deliver the remaining jar to finish
Request a hint and confirm both highlighted candies form a legal move that supports the active objectives
expected: Jam jars are readable, fixed objective pieces. They never match or swap, effects cannot destroy them directly, clears in their column drop them toward the exit, and every ingredient plus the paired objective is required to win.

name: Seeded motion A/B, rapid input, and interruption recovery
description: Uses the development-only profiler to compare the same move and verify cancellation paths without changing production defaults.
steps: In development, open the same level with ?perfTrace=1&motion=compact&perfSeed=12345 and make a legal move
Repeat from the same level with ?perfTrace=1&motion=readable&perfSeed=12345 and the same board move; compare board fingerprints and move reports
Repeat with ?perfTrace=1&motion=compact&perfSeed=12345&perfEffects=off to isolate ambient and burst effects
Tap another pair rapidly during a clear or fall, then verify no extra move starts
Restart during a multi-wave cascade and verify the new board accepts input
Resize the viewport during a swap or fall and verify the move settles
Enable the operating-system reduced-motion preference and try both a legal and rejected swap
expected: Seeded runs use matching boards and coordinates, completed moves record input unlock with phase timings, rapid input never overlaps a resolver, restart and resize cannot leave a stale lock, and reduced motion still resolves the game state.

name: Campaign progression and booster economy
covers: level completion stars only after a win
campaign star total excludes failed attempts
description: Verifies campaign navigation, genuine level completion, winning-score stars, sound, and booster accounting.
steps: Open the world map
Switch to the next world and back
Select the current unlocked level and inspect its objective
Start the level, equip and use an available power-up
Verify the charge and move count change
Complete or lose a level, then reload
expected: The map shows twelve worlds with ten levels each (120 total), locked levels cannot be opened, selected late-world milestone levels clearly show two required objectives, the star cap is 360 and stars use a winning run rather than a failed personal best, each power-up use consumes one charge and one move, and campaign progress remains on the device after reload.

name: Prism Orchard and Moonmallow Observatory expansion
covers: existing saves unlock beyond level 100 without losing saved records
worlds 11 and 12 navigate as ten-level chapters
new boss finales on levels 110 and 120
four-color Moon Mix boards on levels 111–120
lightweight original prism and moon map illustrations
description: Checks the campaign extension and its distinct, four-color final-world rule without resetting legacy player progress.
steps: Use a QA save with level 100 complete; reload and confirm level 101 is unlocked and earlier scores/stars remain
Open world 11, inspect levels 101–110 and the Lady Luma chapter-finale preview
Open world 12 and confirm levels 111–120, the Mallow Nova finale, and the Moon Mix four-color palette label
Start one Moon Mix level and confirm only grape, lemon, blueberry, and orange candies spawn; reload and verify progress remains saved
On a narrow mobile viewport, verify the new chapter art and ten level buttons keep the existing board/map layout usable
expected: The campaign shows 120 levels across twelve ten-level worlds; previous local progress is retained, new boss levels unlock normally, Moon Mix levels use exactly four available colors, and the original inline-vector chapter art requires no external image assets.

name: In-game install option and Home Screen launch
covers: visible Install Jam Shift control on the title screen
Android browser menu instructions when native prompting is unavailable
iOS Safari Add to Home Screen instructions
installed standalone mode hides the install control
description: Checks that players can find installation again after dismissing an earlier browser prompt, including the manual iOS path.
steps: Open the HTTPS game link in Android Chrome and confirm Install Jam Shift is visible on the title screen
Tap the button; accept or dismiss the native install prompt, then confirm the fallback instructions remain available if needed
Open the same link in iPhone Safari, tap Install Jam Shift, and follow Share then Add to Home Screen
Launch the installed icon and confirm the in-browser install action is hidden while running standalone
expected: The button either opens the browser install prompt or shows platform-appropriate steps. After installation, the standalone app opens without showing a redundant install action.

name: Development-only campaign playtest launch
covers: query-selectable authored level in Vite development mode
all campaign levels unlocked only for local playtesting
normal local save is not loaded or overwritten in playtest mode
production mode ignores the playtest query
description: Provides a safe way to reach the flagged levels for human testing without shipping a level-unlock shortcut or contaminating campaign saves.
steps: Run npm run dev and open the preview URL with ?playtest=79
Confirm the map selects level 79, all levels are unlocked, and the Local playtest banner says progress will not be saved
Play or leave the level, reload, and confirm the test session did not change the ordinary saved campaign
Open a production build with the same query and confirm normal campaign access rules remain in effect
expected: Valid playtest URLs open directly to a requested level in development mode with in-memory progress only; malformed levels fall back safely, and production ignores the query.
